newsitem.title: USA: Summit Technology names Palmisano CEO.
newsitem.headline: Summit Technology names Palmisano CEO.

text.p: Summit Technology Inc said Tuesday it named Robert Palmisano chief executive and a member of the board.
The company said Palmisano replaces the interim chief executive Verne Sharma who will continue in the role of president with a focus on Summit's opthalmic laser business.
Sharma served in the interim post after the company ousted David Muller as chairman and chief executive in September, 1996.

"On behalf of the Board, I want to thank Verne Sharma and the other members of Summit's senior management team for guiding the company through a very turbulent and difficult six month period," said Richard Traskos, Summit's current chairman.
Palmisano most recently served as senior vice president of Bausch & Lomb Inc and president of its eyewear division.
